# N15: Said once: an ask’s words, this week’s reason, and what a goal measures, each in one place on its page

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/11-said-once.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

said once on a goal's page (goal spec, GT1). On every demo goal with an open ask, the ask's words are in exactly one element of the page (in Next steps and asks), "What it measures" is in exactly one, and this week's reason is in exactly one (Why; History points to it, GT2).
